checks.quote: Inject current to drive strictly controlled numbers
checks.reason: The proposed validation lacks a complete role-defined positive, negative/null and optical procedural control set. Motion discussion or generic calibration alone does not prospectively design all necessary comparisons.

checks.quote: higher level of time-integrated intracellular calcium binding

checks.quote: higher level of time-integrated intracellular calcium binding
checks.reason: Proposes spike/fluorescence calibration but does not specify a measurement-error/noise or recovery acceptance criterion and the action if calibration fails; a fitted curve or plateau inspection alone is incomplete.

checks.quote: higher level of time-integrated intracellular calcium binding
checks.reason: No fully defined endpoint with baseline/background calculation, units/denominator and weak/near-zero/saturated/missing-signal handling. Naming delta-F/F and spike counts is not the complete measurement rule.
The validation gives a calibration example but no negative/ambiguous outcome branch separating motion, non-spike calcium and technical calibration failure.

checks.quote: higher level of time-integrated intracellular calcium binding
checks.reason: Operational simultaneous electrical spike recording and imaging of the same cell provides an independent measurement; comparisons of count/timing and fluorescence, with acknowledged optical/calcium ambiguities, meet essay-scale validation. Extra optional reporters are not treated as independent ground truth.

checks.quote: finite number of binding sites, characterized by their dissociation constant
checks.reason: Two independent errors: Kd describes affinity, not binding-site number/capacity; an indicator does not report total intracellular calcium (free, bound and sequestered pools).

checks.quote: higher level of time-integrated intracellular calcium binding
checks.reason: An unspecified optical response with possible motion does not establish an integrated calcium-bound quantity.
E1 labels the teaching figures synthetic; it does not specify that the indicator is a synthetic chemical sensor.
